channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Goolhayihii hore ee Real Madrid iyo Betis, Antonio Adán, oo 39 jir ku dhawaaqay inuu ka fariistay kubadda cagta
item.description: Goolhayaha reer Spain Antonio Adán, oo ay da'diisu tahay 39 sano, ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqay inuu ka fariistay kubadda cagta xirfadeed, kaddib xirfad uu ku guuleystay 11 koob.

item.title: Mucaaradka Soomaaliya iyo mowqifka Imaaraadka: Siyaasad mise dano qaran?
item.description: Waxaa soo baxaya warar sheegaya in xubno ka tirsan mucaaradka Soomaaliyeed oo maanta shir yeeshay ay suuragal tahay inay taageero siyaasadeed u muujiyaan mowqifka Imaaraadka Carabta ee ku aaddan xaaladda Soomaaliya.

item.title: Dallas Cowboys oo Christian Parker kala wareegay hoggaaminta qorshaha difaaca, Mike Pettine oo loo dhiibay
item.description: Dallas Cowboys ayaa isku-duwaha difaaca Christian Parker kala wareegay masuuliyadda u yeerista ciyaaraha difaaca inta kulanku socdo, waxaana xilkaas la wareegaya kaaliyaha sare Mike Pettine.

item.title: Carlos Alcaraz oo 6-2, 6-4 ku garaacay Daniil Medvedev, kuna dhow semi-finalka ATP Finals ee Turin
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz ayaa Arbacadii 6-2, 6-4 kaga adkaaday Daniil Medvedev tartanka ATP Finals ee magaalada Turin, isagoo hadda ku guuleystay labadii kulan ee ugu horreeyay ee kooxdiisa.

item.title: Madaxweynaha Bayern Herbert Hainer: Michael Olise lama iibin doono xitaa haddii 300 milyan euro la bixiyo
item.description: Madaxweynaha Bayern Munich Herbert Hainer ayaa sheegay in kooxdu aysan ahayn mid iibisa ciyaartoyda, kuna dhawaaqay in xiddigga reer France Michael Olise uu kooxda sii joogi doono muddo dheer.

item.title: Riek Machar oo maxkamadda u sheegay in Salva Kiir uusan ka jawaabin codsigiisii dib u dhigista ciidamada Nasir
item.description: Madaxweyne ku xigeenkii koowaad ee hore ee Koonfur Suudaan, Riek Machar, ayaa Arbacadii maxkamadda gaarka ah ee Juba u sheegay in Madaxweyne Salva Kiir uusan ka jawaabin warqad uu ku codsaday in laba toddobaad dib loogu dhigo geynta ciidamada SSPDF ee Nasir.

item.title: LeBron James oo dacwad ka gudbiyay app-ka sharadka Bron, kuna eedeeyay inuu magaciisa si sharci darro ah u isticmaalay
item.description: Xiddigga kubadda koleyga LeBron James ayaa Talaadadii maxkamad federaal ah oo ku taal New York ka gudbiyay dacwad uu ku eedeeyay shirkadda app-ka Bron inay isticmaashay naanaystiisa iyo muuqaal lagu sameeyay garaadka macmalka ah (AI) iyadoon ogolaansho haysan.

item.title: Vincent Kompany oo Khamiista ku soo laabanaya shirka jaraa'id ee Bayern, kulanka Köln oo la filayo inuu hoggaamiyo
item.description: Bayern Munich ayaa Arbacadii shaacisay in tababaraha kooxda Vincent Kompany uu Khamiista ka qeyb geli doono shirka jaraa'id ee ka horreeya kulanka Bundesliga ee 1. FC Köln, markii ugu horreysay tan iyo markii isbitaalka loo dhigay.

item.title: Ruto oo khudbaddiisa afraad ee xaaladda qaranka ku difaacay dhaqaalaha, deynta Kenya oo gaartay Sh13.47 trillion
item.description: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa Arbacadii baarlamaanka hortiisa ka jeediyay khudbaddiisii afraad ee xaaladda qaranka, isagoo difaacay siyaasaddiisa dhaqaale, xilli deynta guud ee dalka ay gaartay Sh13.47 trillion.

item.title: Al-Shabaab oo hoobiyeyaal ku weeraray deegaanka Af-urur ee gobolka Bari
item.description: Al-Shabaab ayaa Arbacadii subaxnimo hoobiyeyaal ku weeraray deegaanka Af-urur ee gobolka Bari ee Puntland, mana jiro khasaare la soo sheegay oo ka dhashay weerarka.

item.title: Juventus oo dib u heshay Edon Zhegrova ka hor kulanka Venezia, Cambiaso iyo Celik oo baaritaan sugaya
item.description: Xiddigga Juventus Edon Zhegrova ayaa Arbacadii si buuxda ula tababaray kooxda, iyadoo Juventus ay u diyaar garoobayso kulanka Serie A ee Venezia ee Axadda.

item.title: Soomaaliya oo soo dhaweysay dhaqangalka Heshiiska IGAD ee 2023
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay soo dhaweysay dhaqangalka Heshiiska 2023 ee lagu aasaasay Hay’adda Dowladaha ee Horumarinta (IGAD), kaas oo dhaqan galay 16 November 2026.

item.title: Eintracht Frankfurt oo xaqiijisay in agaasimaha cusub ee ciyaaraha Joti Chatzialexiou uu shaqada bilaabayo 1 December
item.description: Eintracht Frankfurt ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqday in agaasimaha cusub ee ciyaaraha ee kooxda, Joti Chatzialexiou, uu shaqadiisa bilaabi doono 1 December 2026, laba bilood ka hor wakhtigii markii hore la qorsheeyay.

item.title: Guddiga KMI ee Premier League oo xaqiijiyay 6 qalad oo garsoor wareeggii u dambeeyay, tirada ugu badan ee hal toddobaad
item.description: Guddiga Dhacdooyinka Muhiimka ah ee Kulamada (KMI) ee Premier League ayaa go'aamiyay in garsoorayaashu ay galeen 6 qalad wareeggii u dambeeyay ee horyaalka, taas oo la mid ah tirada ugu badan ee guddigu uu weligii diiwaangeliyay hal toddobaad.

item.title: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo ku baaqay in Soomaaliya laga sameeyo tirakoob dadweyne oo dhammaystiran
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa Arbacadii Muqdisho ka sheegay in loo baahan yahay tirakoob dhammaystiran oo lagu ogaado tirada saxda ah ee dadka iyo guryaha dalka.

item.title: De Laurentiis oo saxiixay heshiiska hordhaca ah ee iibsashada dhulka xarunta tababarka cusub ee Napoli ee Qualiano
item.description: Madaxweynaha Napoli Aurelio De Laurentiis ayaa Arbacadii magaalada Naples ku saxiixay heshiiska hordhaca ah ee iibsashada dhul ku yaal Qualiano, halkaas oo laga dhisi doono xarunta tababarka cusub ee kooxda.

item.title: War degdeg ah: Wasiir Ayuub Ismaaciil Yuusuf oo jawaab kulul ka bixiyay La-taliyaha Imaaraadka Anwar Gargash
item.description: Wasiirka Hawlaha Guud, Dib-u-dhiska iyo Guriyeynta, Ayuub Ismaaciil Yuusuf, ayaa jawaab adag ka bixiyay hadal uu soo saaray La-taliyaha Madaxweynaha Imaaraadka, Dr. Anwar Gargash, isaga oo sheegay in Soomaaliya aan lagu iibsan karin lacag.

item.title: Taliyaha ciidanka Iran oo ku hanjabay jawaab ka sii daran haddii Mareykanku mar kale weeraro
item.description: Taliyaha guud ee ciidanka Iran, Amir Hatami, ayaa Arbacadii sheegay in haddii Iran mar kale la weeraro ay bixin doonto jawaab ka sii daran oo aan xad juqraafi lahayn, sida ay werisay Euronews.

item.title: Ururka garsoorayaasha Spain oo dalbaday tallaabooyin degdeg ah kaddib rabshado ka dhacay Catalunya
item.description: Ururka Garsoorayaasha Kubbadda Cagta ee Spain (AESAF) ayaa Arbacadii ku baaqay tallaabooyin degdeg ah, kaddib waxa uu ku tilmaamay rabshado culus oo soo noqnoqday oo loo geystay garsoorayaal ka shaqeeya gobolka Catalunya.

item.title: Trump oo gaaray Shenzhen, Xi Jinping oo garoonka ku soo dhoweeyay ka hor shirka saddex geesoodka ah
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Arbacadii gaaray magaalada Shenzhen ee Shiinaha, halkaas oo uu Xi Jinping ku soo dhoweeyay garoonka diyaaradaha, ka hor shir saddex geesood ah oo Khamiista uu la yeelanayo Xi iyo Vladimir Putin.

item.title: England oo Australia kaga adkaatay 97 orod Hobart, kuna guuleysatay taxanaha ODI, Duckett oo dhaliyay 133
item.description: Xulka cricket-ka England ayaa ciyaartii saddexaad ee ODI ee Hobart kaga guuleystay Australia 97 orod, kuna guuleystay taxanaha, iyadoo Ben Duckett uu dhaliyay 133 orod.

item.title: Globe Soccer Awards 2026: Dembélé oo difaacanaya abaalmarintiisa, PSG iyo Barcelona oo musharraxiin badan leh
item.description: Liisaska musharraxiinta abaalmarinta 17-aad ee Globe Soccer Awards ayaa la shaaciyay, iyadoo codbixinta taageerayaasha ee internetka ay furantay Arbacadii, Ousmane Dembélé-na uu difaacanayo abaalmarinta ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican.

item.title: Amadou Onana oo heshiis cusub la saxiixday Aston Villa, xilli uu ka soo kabanayo qalliin jilibka ah
item.description: Aston Villa ayaa Arbacadii si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqday in xiddigga khadka dhexe ee reer Belgium Amadou Onana uu heshiis cusub la saxiixday kooxda, isagoo weli ka soo kabanaya qalliin lagu sameeyay jilibkiisa.

item.title: Arda Güler oo heshiis cusub la saxiixday Real Madrid, kana dhigaya ilaa 2032
item.description: Real Madrid ayaa Arbacadii si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqday inay heshiiska xiddigga reer Turkiga Arda Güler ku kordhisay ilaa 30-ka Juun 2032, kaddib markii heshiiskiisii hore uu ahaa ilaa 2029.

item.title: Guddiga Yurub oo soo jeediyay amaah cusub oo €45 bilyan ah oo Ukraine loo siinayo 2027
item.description: Madaxweynaha Guddiga Yurub, Ursula von der Leyen, ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqday amaah €45 bilyan ah oo la soo jeediyay oo Ukraine loo siinayo sannadka 2027, taas oo lagu bixin doono magdhowga dagaalka ee mustaqbalka ee Ruushka.

item.title: Dybala oo diyaar u ah inuu Roma ugu soo laabto kulanka Parma, Gasperini oo dib u helay afar ciyaaryahan
item.description: Xiddigga Roma Paulo Dybala ayaa la tababaray kooxda oo dhan, wuxuuna diyaar u yahay kulanka Sabtida ee Parma, iyadoo Gian Piero Gasperini uu dib u helay afar ciyaaryahan oo aasaasi ah.

item.title: Dukumentiyada FIFA oo muujinaya in nasashada biyo-cabbidda ay sii jiri doonto Koobka Adduunka 2030
item.description: Dukumentiyada ay FIFA u diyaarisay iibinta xuquuqda telefishinka ee Koobka Adduunka 2030 ayaa ku jira qodob u oggolaanaya idaacadaha inay xayeysiis ku iibiyaan inta lagu jiro nasashada biyo-cabbidda, sida ay werisay The Guardian.

item.title: Cameron Bancroft oo sheegay in kooxda Australia oo dhan ay ogeyd qorshihii sandpaper-ka 2018
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka cricket-ka Australia Cameron Bancroft ayaa sheegay in dhammaan kooxdii Australia ay ka warqabtay qorshihii kubbadda lagu xoqay ee 2018, hadal cadaadis saaraya kabtanka hadda Pat Cummins.

item.title: Conor Bradley iyo Giovanni Leoni oo dib ugu laabtay tababarka kooxda Liverpool kaddib dhaawacyo dhaadheer
item.description: Difaacyada Liverpool Conor Bradley iyo Giovanni Leoni ayaa dib ula tababaray kooxda koowaad, kaddib muddo dheer oo ay ka maqnaayeen dhaawacyo jilibka ah.

item.title: Sam Prendergast oo loo oggolaaday inuu Ireland u ciyaaro kulanka Koonfur Afrika kaddib go'aan guddi
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka rugby-ga Ireland Sam Prendergast ayaa loo oggolaaday inuu ciyaaro kulanka Sabtida ee Nations Championship ee Koonfur Afrika, kaddib markii guddi go'aamiyay in taakulayntiisii Fiji aysan u qalmin kaarka cas.
